components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Emerald fill for the one primary action in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--accent, #10B981); color: var(--accent-ink, #04120C); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-bright, #34D399); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,211,153,0.35); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised surface with hairline border for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--bg-raised, #161C19); color: var(--text-1, #ECF2EE); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #1A211D); border-color: var(--border-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.14)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,211,153,0.35); }

components.name: Send Button
components.description: Circular emerald send at the composer's bottom right.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" aria-label="Send message"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 19V5M5.5 11.5 12 5l6.5 6.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: var(--accent, #10B981); color: var(--accent-ink, #04120C); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-send:hover { background: var(--accent-bright, #34D399); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,211,153,0.35); }

components.name: Context Chip
components.description: Mono file/symbol chip pinned into the composer context.
components.html: src/session/lookup.rs
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 6px 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); background: var(--bg-inset, #0D1210); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2, #A8B5AD); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-x { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: none; background: none; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--text-3, #8C9991); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-x:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #1A211D); color: var(--text-1, #ECF2EE); }

components.name: Live Badge
components.description: Emerald-tinted pill naming a live state or mode.
components.css: .ds-badge-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--accent-text, #34D399); background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12); }

components.name: Session Pulse
components.description: Signature move: breathing mint dot marking a live agent session.
components.css: .ds-pulse { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-bright, #34D399); } .ds-pulse::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -3px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--accent-bright, #34D399); opacity: 0; animation: ds-pulse-ring 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-ring { 0% { transform: scale(0.6); opacity: 0.8; } 70% { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 0; } 100% { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pulse::after { animation: none; } }

components.name: Mode Toggle
components.description: Plan / Build / Autonomous segmented control in the composer bar.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; gap: 2px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-inset, #0D1210); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); } .ds-seg button { padding: 4px 10px; border: none; background: none; border-radius: 7px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-3, #8C9991); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--text-1, #ECF2EE); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12); color: var(--accent-text, #34D399); font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,211,153,0.35); }

components.css: .ds-diff { border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-pane, #111614); overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; max-width: 560px; } .ds-diff-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); font-size: 12px; } .ds-diff-file { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-1, #ECF2EE); } .ds-diff-stat { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-diff-body { background: var(--bg-inset, #0D1210); padding: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-diff-line { display: flex; min-width: max-content; padding: 4px 12px; } .ds-ln { width: 44px; text-align: right; padding-right: 8px; color: var(--text-3, #8C9991); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mark { width: 20px; text-align: center; } .ds-src { white-space: pre; color: var(--text-1, #ECF2EE); } .ds-add { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.10); } .ds-add .ds-mark { color: var(--accent-text, #34D399); } .ds-del { background: rgba(248,113,113,0.09); } .ds-del .ds-mark { color: var(--danger, #F87171); } .ds-diff-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); } .ds-hint { flex: 1; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3, #8C9991); } .ds-accept { background: var(--accent, #10B981); color: var(--accent-ink, #04120C); border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-accept:hover { background: var(--accent-bright, #34D399); } .ds-reject { background: none; border: none; color: var(--danger, #F87171); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-reject:hover { background: rgba(248,113,113,0.12); }

components.name: Composer Input
components.description: The anchored chat composer; focus shifts border to emerald with a ring.
components.css: .ds-composer { border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.14)); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bg-raised, #161C19); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; max-width: 560px; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #10B981); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,211,153,0.35); } .ds-composer-input { display: block; width: 100%; border: none; background: transparent; resize: none; padding: 12px 16px 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--text-1, #ECF2EE); caret-color: var(--accent-bright, #34D399); min-height: 64px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-3, #8C9991); } .ds-composer-input:focus { outline: none; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: 56px icon rail; the active view carries an emerald tint plus full inset ring.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 8px; background: var(--bg-app, #0B0E0D); border-right: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); } .ds-rail-link { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text-3, #8C9991); transition: color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-rail-link:hover { color: var(--text-1, #ECF2EE); background: var(--bg-hover, #1A211D); } .ds-rail-link.is-active { color: var(--accent-text, #34D399); background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(52,211,153,0.35); } .ds-rail-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,211,153,0.35); }

narrative.overview: RayuCode Desktop is one obsidian window where a developer supervises a swarm of coding agents. The interface is calm and dense like a well-kept editor: hairline seams divide panes, monospace carries every measurement, and green appears only where something is alive, selected, primary, or succeeded. Dark is the default for long desk sessions; the light theme is crisp alabaster with rich jade for daylight rooms. Both themes share one token system; a view never invents its own palette.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian #0B0E0D / slate-charcoal #111614 grounds; emerald #10B981 / mint #34D399 accents (light: alabaster #FAFAFA, jade #059669 / forest #047857)
Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for code, data, and every numeral (tabular)
Hairline 1px borders as the primary depth device; one soft-shadow voice for raised surfaces only
The session pulse: a breathing emerald dot ties rail, sidebar row, and stream header to one live session

rules.name: The Green Means Alive Rule
rules.body: Green marks state and action only: live sessions, selection, primary actions, success, diff additions. Never a decorative wash, never a gradient fill.

rules.name: The One Token System Rule
rules.body: Every view and both themes read from tokens.css; [data-theme=light] overrides values, never structure.

rules.name: The Mono Measures Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for code, data, and measurement only, never as a technical costume for prose.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Declare elevation once per surface: a hairline border or a shadow, never a border under a wide soft shadow.

dos: Do keep green to the state-and-action vocabulary
Do set every numeral in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures
Do hold body and meta text at 4.5:1 or better on its actual surface in both themes
Do use the full inset ring plus tint for selection
donts: Don't use one-sided border bars, gradient text, decorative glow halos, or hard offset shadows
Don't nest cards or wrap a pane in another card
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as icons; extend assets/icons.svg in the same 1.75px stroke
Don't invent prices, benchmarks, or customer claims
Don't pick a theme by category; dark is the pinned default and light is a first-class equal
